title: 🏥 Stafford, VA Healthcare Roles: Several SLP Openings to Explore
text:
1 days ago Stafford is busy hiring for school-based and home health speech roles right now. If you’re an SLP or new grad, there are some solid options with different schedules and settings.
School Speech-Language Pathologist, Clinical Fellowship Year Employer: Plan A Health Location: Stafford, VA (school-based, travel) Type: Full-time Salary/Benefits: Competitive pay, health coverage, 401(k), CE , and housing options Travel School SLP role in a school setting, perfect if you’re starting your CF year or are early in your career. You’ll handle assessments, IEPs, individual and group therapy, and staff training while working closely with students, teachers, and families.
School Speech Language Pathologist - Stafford, VA Employer: Soliant Location: Near Stafford, VA (single elementary campus) Type: Part-time (.5 FTE, ~18.75 hrs/week) Salary: Not listed Contract role focused on elementary students at one school, great if you want a steady part-time schedule and work–life balance. You’ll provide therapy, complete evals, write IEPs, and collaborate with a supportive school team on-site.
